description.value: Camp Lifestyle & Coffee Co. is a mountain espresso bar and lifestyle store in Whistler, BC, serving third-wave coffee using 49th Parallel beans in a space that celebrates West Coast outdoor culture. The store occupies two levels — a ground-floor espresso bar and a curated loft with designer clothing and homewares — and features an outdoor seating area called The Camp Site with Adirondack chairs, a fountain, and a fire pit. For touring cyclists rolling through Whistler, it offers quality coffee and a relaxed outdoor spot to sit and decompress.
